summary:
All 5 functional tests pass and the performance test drops from N+1 (101 queries) to 2 queries — 1 for users, 1 batched for all their posts.

**The fix:** `createContext()` in `context.ts` now calls `createLoaders(db)` and attaches the loaders to the context. Both resolvers were creating fresh `DataLoader` instances on every call (so each loader only ever saw 1 key), and are now replaced with single lines that use `ctx.loaders.userLoader` / `ctx.loaders.postsByAuthorLoader` — the per-request shared instances that DataLoader needs to batch across all resolver invocations in the same tick.
